links.note: Was 32760 (A Magnet in the Sawdust), which matches only on the word sawdust. Potatoes, salt and sawdust needing a stepwise procedure is the ordering exercise 32763 is built on - the order changes what is possible later.
Was 32753 (Seawater Left in the Sun). The Intelligent Leela story, with a choice of method at each step, is described in 32763.

Was 32749 (Picking Stones Out by Hand), which covers only one of the five statements. The whole true/false set - sun-dried salt solution, handpicking quantity, puffed rice by threshing, mustard oil and lemon water by decantation, rice flour and water by sieving - is listed in 32762.
